'use client'
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'
import { useVideoTranscribe } from '@/lib/use-video-transcribe'
import { type Seg, mkWords } from '@/lib/subtitle-studio'
import { StudioStyleConfig, getStoredStyle, saveStoredStyle } from '@/lib/studio/unified-style'
import { renderStudioFrame, clampCanvasDimensions } from '@/lib/studio/universal-renderer'
import { ensureFontLoaded } from '@/lib/studio/font-loader'
import TemplatePanel from '../studio/panels/TemplatePanel'
import SubtitleVideoExport from './SubtitleVideoExport'

export default function MobileSubtitleEditor() {
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState('')
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState('')
  const [sourceFile, setSourceFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState<1 | 2 | 4 | 8>(4)
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [showStylePanel, setShowStylePanel] = useState(false)
  const [showExportModal, setShowExportModal] = useState(false)
  const [editingSegId, setEditingSegId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [selectedSegId, setSelectedSegId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const { status, progress, busy, segments, setSegments, run, stop } = useVideoTranscribe()
  const [styleConfig, setStyleConfig] = useState<StudioStyleConfig>(() => getStoredStyle())
  const updateStyle = (patch: Partial<StudioStyleConfig>) => {
    setStyleConfig(prev => { const next = { ...prev, ...patch }; saveStoredStyle(next); return next })
  }

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
  const [fontLoaded, setFontLoaded] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true
    setFontLoaded(false)
    ensureFontLoaded(styleConfig.fontFamily).then(() => { if (active) setFontLoaded(true) })
    return () => { active = false }
  }, [styleConfig.fontFamily])

  const handleFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (!file) return
    if (file.size > 250 * 1024 * 1024) {
      alert('❌ حجم فایل بیش از ۲۵۰ مگابایت است')
      e.target.value = ''
      return
    }
    setFileName(file.name)
    setSourceFile(file)
    setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file))
    await run(file)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = videoRef.current
    if (!video) return
    const onTime = () => setCurrentTime(video.currentTime)
    const onLoaded = () => setDuration(video.duration || 0)
    const onPlay = () => setIsPlaying(true)
    const onPause = () => setIsPlaying(false)
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onLoaded)
    video.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    video.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    return () => {
      video.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onLoaded)
      video.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      video.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
    }
  }, [videoUrl])

  const drawFrame = useCallback(() => {
    const video = videoRef.current
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!video || !canvas || video.readyState < 2) return
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
    if (!ctx) return
    let W = video.videoWidth || 1080
    let H = video.videoHeight || 1920
    if (styleConfig.aspectRatio === '9:16') { W = 1080; H = 1920 }
    else if (styleConfig.aspectRatio === '16:9') { W = 1920; H = 1080 }
    else if (styleConfig.aspectRatio === '1:1') { W = 1080; H = 1080 }
    const clamped = clampCanvasDimensions(W, H, 1920)
    if (canvas.width !== clamped.width || canvas.height !== clamped.height) {
      canvas.width = clamped.width; canvas.height = clamped.height
    }
    renderStudioFrame({ ctx, canvasWidth: clamped.width, canvasHeight: clamped.height, video, currentTime: video.currentTime || currentTime, segments: segments as any, style: styleConfig })
  }, [currentTime, segments, styleConfig])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!fontLoaded) return
    if (!isPlaying) { drawFrame(); return }
    let id: number
    const loop = () => { drawFrame(); id = requestAnimationFrame(loop) }
    id = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id)
  }, [isPlaying, fontLoaded, drawFrame])

  const togglePlay = () => { if (!videoRef.current) return; isPlaying ? videoRef.current.pause() : videoRef.current.play() }
  const seek = (t: number) => { if (!videoRef.current) return; videoRef.current.currentTime = t; setCurrentTime(t) }
  const fmt = (t: number) => { const m = Math.floor(t / 60); const s = Math.floor(t % 60); return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}` }

  const adjustSegTime = (id: string, delta: number) => {
    setSegments(prev => prev.map(s => {
      if (s.id !== id) return s
      const newStart = Math.max(0, s.start + delta)
      const newEnd = Math.max(newStart + 0.2, s.end + delta)
      return { ...s, start: newStart, end: newEnd }
    }))
  }

  const deleteSeg = (id: string) => setSegments(prev => prev.filter(s => s.id !== id))

  const addSeg = () => {
    const text = 'متن جدید'
    const start = currentTime
    const end = currentTime + 2.5
    const newSeg: Seg = {
      id: `seg_${Date.now()}`,
      text,
      start,
      end,
      words: mkWords(text, start, end),
    }
    setSegments(prev => [...prev, newSeg])
  }

  const splitSeg = (id: string) => {
    const seg = segments.find(s => s.id === id)
    if (!seg) return
    const mid = currentTime
    if (mid <= seg.start || mid >= seg.end) return
    const first: Seg = { ...seg, end: mid }
    const second: Seg = { ...seg, id: `seg_${Date.now()}`, start: mid }
    setSegments(prev => prev.flatMap(s => s.id === id ? [first, second] : [s]))
  }

  if (!videoUrl) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col min-h-screen bg-[#070605]" dir="rtl">
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl border border-stone-800 bg-[#12100d] p-8 text-center">
            <div className="text-5xl mb-4">🎬</div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-white mb-2">ویدیوی خود را وارد کنید</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 mb-6">حداکثر ۲۵۰ مگابایت</p>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mb-6">
              <span className="text-xs text-stone-400">سرعت:</span>
              {([1, 2, 4, 8] as const).map(s => (
                <button key={s} onClick={() => setSpeed(s)} className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${speed === s ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black' : 'bg-stone-900 text-stone-400'}`}>{s}x</button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <label className="block w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-500 py-3 text-xs font-black text-black">
              انتخاب ویدیو
              <input type="file" accept="video/*,.mov,.mp4" onChange={handleFile} className="hidden" />
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-[#070605]" dir="rtl">
      <video ref={videoRef} src={videoUrl || undefined} className="hidden" playsInline />

      {/* هدر */}
      <div className="shrink-0 border-b border-stone-800 bg-[#110f0d] px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-xs font-black text-white truncate max-w-[120px]">{fileName}</h1>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button onClick={() => setShowStylePanel(true)} className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 text-[10px] font-bold">🎨</button>
          <button onClick={() => setShowExportModal(true)} className="rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-500 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-black text-black">خروجی</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* بخش ویدیو (۴۵٪ ارتفاع) */}
      <div className="h-[45vh] shrink-0 flex flex-col bg-black items-center justify-center p-2 relative overflow-hidden">
        {busy && (
          <div className="absolute top-2 inset-x-3 z-20 bg-stone-900/90 border border-amber-500/40 p-2 rounded-xl backdrop-blur-md">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] mb-1">
              <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{status}</span>
              <button onClick={stop} className="text-red-400">توقف</button>
            </div>
            <div className="h-1 w-full bg-stone-800 rounded-full"><div className="h-full bg-amber-500" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} /></div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div onClick={togglePlay} className="relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-black cursor-pointer border border-stone-800">
          <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="max-h-full max-w-full object-contain" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* کنترلر پلیر */}
      <div className="shrink-0 bg-[#110f0d] border-b border-stone-800 px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button onClick={togglePlay} className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-black font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-sm">{isPlaying ? '⏸' : '▶'}</button>
        <input type="range" min={0} max={duration || 1} step={0.05} value={currentTime} onChange={e => seek(Number(e.target.value))} className="flex-1 accent-amber-500" />
        <span className="font-mono text-[9px] text-stone-400 shrink-0">{fmt(currentTime)}</span>
      </div>

      {/* تایم‌لاین حرفه‌ای (۵٪ ارتفاع) */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-[#0e0d0b] overflow-hidden min-h-0">
        <div className="shrink-0 px-3 py-2 border-b border-stone-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#12100d]">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-white">تایم‌لاین ({segments.length})</span>
          <button onClick={addSeg} className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400 rounded text-[9px] font-bold">+ افزودن</button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1.5">
          {segments.length === 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-stone-500 text-xs">هنوز کپشنی وجود ندارد</div>
          )}
          {segments.map((seg: any) => {
            const isActive = currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end
            const isSelected = selectedSegId === seg.id
            const isEditing = editingSegId === seg.id
            const readingSpeed = seg.text.length / (seg.end - seg.start)
            const isFast = readingSpeed > 17
            return (
              <div key={seg.id} onClick={() => { setSelectedSegId(seg.id); setEditingSegId(seg.id); seek(seg.start) }} className={`rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${isActive ? 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/60' : isSelected ? 'bg-stone-800/60 border-amber-500/40' : 'bg-stone-900/60 border-stone-800'}`}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1 border-b border-stone-800/50">
                  <span className="bg-stone-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-amber-400 font-mono text-[9px]">{fmt(seg.start)} - {fmt(seg.end)}</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                    <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); adjustSegTime(seg.id, -0.5) }} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-stone-800 text-[9px] text-stone-300">-0.5</button>
                    <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); adjustSegTime(seg.id, 0.5) }} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-stone-800 text-[9px] text-stone-300">+0.5</button>
                    <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); splitSeg(seg.id) }} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-stone-800 text-[9px] text-stone-300">✂</button>
                    <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteSeg(seg.id) }} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 text-[9px]"></button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {isEditing ? (
                  <div className="p-2">
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      value={seg.text}
                      onChange={e => setSegments(prev => prev.map((s: any) => s.id === seg.id ? { ...s, text: e.target.value } : s))}
                      onBlur={() => setEditingSegId(null)}
                      onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
                      autoFocus
                      className="w-full bg-black/40 border border-amber-500/50 rounded p-1.5 text-[11px] text-white focus:outline-none resize-none"
                    />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-white/90 line-clamp-2 relative">
                    {seg.text}
                    {isFast && <span className="absolute top-1 left-1 text-red-500 text-[9px]">⚠</span>}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* پنل استایل (از سمت چپ) */}
      {showStylePanel && (
        <div className="fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-80 bg-[#12100d] border-r border-stone-800 shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="sticky top-0 bg-[#12100d] border-b border-stone-800 p-3 flex items-center justify-between z-10">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">تنظیمات استایل</h3>
            <button onClick={() => setShowStylePanel(false)} className="text-stone-400 hover:text-white">✕</button>
          </div>
          <TemplatePanel config={styleConfig} onChange={updateStyle} onClose={() => setShowStylePanel(false)} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* مودال خروجی */}
      {showExportModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl bg-[#14120f] border border-stone-800 p-4 shadow-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 border-b border-stone-800 pb-2">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">خروجی ویدیو</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowExportModal(false)} className="text-stone-400">✕</button>
            </div>
            <SubtitleVideoExport videoUrl={videoUrl} sourceFile={sourceFile} segments={segments as any} style={styleConfig as any} baseName={fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '')} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { PRESETS, FONTS } from './constants'
import { Preset, Snapshot } from './types'

interface Props {
  style: Record<string, any>
  fontId: string
  onClose: () => void
  onApplyPreset: (preset: Preset) => void
  onApplyFont: (id: string) => void
  onUpdateStyle: (patch: Record<string, unknown>, record?: boolean) => void
  makeSnapshot: () => Snapshot
  recordBefore: (snapshot?: Snapshot) => void
}

export default function StylePanel({ 
  style, fontId, onClose, onApplyPreset, onApplyFont, onUpdateStyle, makeSnapshot, recordBefore 
}: Props) {
  const x = Number(style.x ?? 50)
  const y = Number(style.y ?? 90)
  const beforeStyleDragRef = useRef<Snapshot | null>(null)

  const handleDragStart = () => { beforeStyleDragRef.current = makeSnapshot() }
  const handleDragEnd = () => { 
    if (beforeStyleDragRef.current) {
      recordBefore(beforeStyleDragRef.current)
      beforeStyleDragRef.current = null
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-black/70" onMouseDown={onClose}>
      <section 
        onMouseDown={e => e.stopPropagation()} 
        className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-full max-w-[430px] overflow-y-auto border-r border-stone-800 bg-[#12100d] shadow-2xl"
      >
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-stone-800 bg-[#12100d] p-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-black">استایل زیرنویس</h2>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">قالب، فونت و تنظیمات در یک‌جا</p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg bg-stone-800 px-3 py-1.5">✕</button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="space-y-6 p-4">
          {/* قالب‌ها */}
          <section>
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold">قالب‌ها</h3>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">{PRESETS.length} قالب</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {PRESETS.map(p => (
                <button 
                  key={p.id} 
                  onClick={() => onApplyPreset(p)} 
                  className={`rounded-xl border p-2 text-right transition-all ${
                    style.template === p.id ? 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10' : 'border-stone-800 bg-stone-900/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div 
                    className="mb-2 rounded-lg px-2 py-3 text-center" 
                    style={{ 
                      background: p.bgColor, 
                      borderRadius: p.bgRadius,
                      border: p.outline ? `1px solid ${p.color}40` : 'none',
                      boxShadow: p.outline ? `0 0 8px ${p.color}30` : 'none'
                    }}
                  >
                    <span 
                      style={{ 
                        fontFamily: `"${p.fontId}"`, 
                        color: p.color, 
                        fontSize: 15, 
                        fontWeight: 800, 
                        textShadow: p.outline 
                          ? `0 0 4px ${p.textShadowColor}, 0 0 8px ${p.textShadowColor}` 
                          : `0 2px ${p.textShadowBlur}px ${p.textShadowColor}`,
                        letterSpacing: p.karaoke ? '0.5px' : 'normal',
                        textTransform: p.id === 'bold' ? 'uppercase' : 'none'
                      }}
                    >
                      نمونه زیرنویس
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-bold">{p.name}</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-[9px] text-stone-500">{p.fontId}</div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* فونت‌ها */}
          <section>
            <h3 className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold">فونت‌ها</h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {FONTS.map(f => (
                <button 
                  key={f.id} 
                  onClick={() => onApplyFont(f.id)} 
                  className={`rounded-xl border p-3 text-right transition-all ${
                    fontId === f.id ? 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10' : 'border-stone-800 bg-stone-900/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div dir="rtl" style={{ fontFamily: `"${f.id}"`, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    این یک متن نمونه است
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-stone-500">{f.label} · {f.category}</div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* اندازه و رنگ */}
          <section className="space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold">اندازه و رنگ</h3>
            <label className="block text-[10px] text-stone-400">
              اندازه: {Number(style.size ?? 6).toFixed(1)}٪ از عرض ویدیو
              <input 
                type="range" 
                min="2" 
                max="12" 
                step=".1" 
                value={Number(style.size ?? 6)} 
                onPointerDown={handleDragStart} 
                onChange={e => onUpdateStyle({ size: Number(e.target.value) }, false)} 
                onPointerUp={handleDragEnd} 
                className="mt-2 w-full accent-amber-500" 
              />
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <label className="rounded-lg bg-stone-900 p-2 text-[10px]">
                رنگ متن
                <input 
                  type="color" 
                  value={style.color ?? '#ffffff'} 
                  onChange={e => onUpdateStyle({ color: e.target.value })} 
                  className="mt-2 h-8 w-full" 
                />
              </label>
              <label className="rounded-lg bg-stone-900 p-2 text-[10px]">
                رنگ کلمه فعال
                <input 
                  type="color" 
                  value={style.hlColor ?? '#ffe14d'} 
                  onChange={e => onUpdateStyle({ hlColor: e.target.value })} 
                  className="mt-2 h-8 w-full" 
                />
              </label>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* موقعیت */}
          <section className="space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold">موقعیت</h3>
            <label className="block text-[10px] text-stone-400">
              X: {x.toFixed(0)}%
              <input 
                type="range" 
                min="5" 
                max="95" 
                value={x} 
                onPointerDown={handleDragStart} 
                onChange={e => onUpdateStyle({ x: Number(e.target.value) }, false)} 
                onPointerUp={handleDragEnd} 
                className="mt-2 w-full accent-amber-500" 
              />
            </label>
            <label className="block text-[10px] text-stone-400">
              Y: {y.toFixed(0)}%
              <input 
                type="range" 
                min="5" 
                max="95" 
                value={y} 
                onPointerDown={handleDragStart} 
                onChange={e => onUpdateStyle({ y: Number(e.target.value) }, false)} 
                onPointerUp={handleDragEnd} 
                className="mt-2 w-full accent-amber-500" 
              />
            </label>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">موقعیت نسبت به خود فریم ویدیو ذخیره می‌شود.</p>
          </section>

          {/* دکمه‌های toggle */}
          <section className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button 
              onClick={() => onUpdateStyle({ karaoke: !Boolean(style.karaoke) })} 
              className={`rounded-xl p-3 text-xs transition-all ${
                style.karaoke ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black' : 'bg-stone-900 text-stone-300'
              }`}
            >
              کلمه فعال {style.karaoke ? 'روشن' : 'خاموش'}
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={() => onUpdateStyle({ outline: !Boolean(style.outline) })} 
              className={`rounded-xl p-3 text-xs transition-all ${
                style.outline ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black' : 'bg-stone-900 text-stone-300'
              }`}
            >
              Outline {style.outline ? 'روشن' : 'خاموش'}
            </button>
          </section>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useVideoTranscribe } from '@/lib/use-video-transcribe'
import { StudioStyleConfig, getStoredStyle, saveStoredStyle } from '@/lib/studio/unified-style'
import { renderStudioFrame, clampCanvasDimensions } from '@/lib/studio/universal-renderer'
import { ensureFontLoaded } from '@/lib/studio/font-loader'
import SubtitleVideoExport from './SubtitleVideoExport'
import { useVideoExport } from '@/lib/video-extract'
import UploadScreen from './UploadScreen'
import StylePanel from './StylePanel'
import { PRESETS, FONTS } from './constants'
import type { Seg, Snapshot, Preset } from './types'

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// توابع کمکی
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const clone = <T,>(v: T): T => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v))

const fmt = (t: number): string => {
  const m = Math.floor(t / 60)
  const s = Math.floor(t % 60)
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
}

let editorIdCounter = 0
const uid = (): string => {
  editorIdCounter++
  return `seg_${Date.now()}_${editorIdCounter}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// کامپوننت واحد (responsive)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function SubtitleEditor() {
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState('')
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState('')
  const [sourceFile, setSourceFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [selectedSegId, setSelectedSegId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [editingSegId, setEditingSegId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [timelineZoom, setTimelineZoom] = useState(100)
  const [showStyle, setShowStyle] = useState(false)
  const [showExport, setShowExport] = useState(false)
  const [showSafe, setShowSafe] = useState(true)
  const [lastSaved, setLastSaved] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [fontLoaded, setFontLoaded] = useState(false)
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<Snapshot[]>([])
  const [redoStack, setRedoStack] = useState<Snapshot[]>([])
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [restored, setRestored] = useState(false)
  const [translating, setTranslating] = useState(false)
  const [generatingCaption, setGeneratingCaption] = useState(false)
  const [captionText, setCaptionText] = useState('')
  const [captionHashtags, setCaptionHashtags] = useState('')
  const [waveform, setWaveform] = useState<number[]>([])
  const [isDraggingSubtitle, setIsDraggingSubtitle] = useState(false)
  const [editingOnCanvas, setEditingOnCanvas] = useState(false)
  const [canvasEditText, setCanvasEditText] = useState('')

  const subtitleDragStart = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; styleX: number; styleY: number } | null>(null)

  const { status, progress, busy, segments, setSegments, run, stop } = useVideoTranscribe()
  const [styleConfig, setStyleConfig] = useState<StudioStyleConfig>(() => getStoredStyle())
  
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
  const timelineScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const dragRef = useRef<{ id: string; mode: 'move' | 'left' | 'right'; startX: number; start: number; end: number } | null>(null)
  const beforeDragRef = useRef<Snapshot | null>(null)
  const beforeStyleDragRef = useRef<Snapshot | null>(null)
  const beforeEditRef = useRef<Snapshot | null>(null)

  const style = styleConfig as unknown as Record<string, any>
  const fontId = style.fontId ?? style.fontFamily ?? 'Vazirmatn'
  const x = Number(style.x ?? 50)
  const y = Number(style.y ?? 90)

  const toastMsg = useCallback((message: string) => {
    setToast(message)
    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(v => v === message ? null : v), 2600)
  }, [])

  const makeSnapshot = useCallback((): Snapshot => ({
    segments: clone(segments),
    style: clone(styleConfig as any),
  }), [segments, styleConfig])

  const recordBefore = useCallback((snapshot?: Snapshot) => {
    const item = snapshot ?? makeSnapshot()
    setHistory(prev => [...prev, item].slice(-80))
    setRedoStack([])
  }, [makeSnapshot])

  const updateStyle = useCallback((patch: Record<string, unknown>, record = true) => {
    if (record) recordBefore()
    setStyleConfig(prev => {
      const next = { ...(prev as any), ...patch } as StudioStyleConfig
      saveStoredStyle(next)
      return next
    })
  }, [recordBefore])

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    setHistory(prev => {
      if (!prev.length) return prev
      const target = prev[prev.length - 1] as Snapshot
      if (!target) return prev
      const current: Snapshot = { segments: clone(segments), style: clone(styleConfig as any) }
      setRedoStack(r => [...r, current].slice(-80))
      setSegments(clone((target as any).segments))
      setStyleConfig((target as any).style as StudioStyleConfig)
      saveStoredStyle((target as any).style)
      return prev.slice(0, -1)
    })
  }, [segments, styleConfig, setSegments])

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    setRedoStack(prev => {
      if (!prev.length) return prev
      const target = prev[prev.length - 1] as Snapshot
      if (!target) return prev
      const current: Snapshot = { segments: clone(segments), style: clone(styleConfig as any) }
      setHistory(h => [...h, current].slice(-80))
      setSegments(clone((target as any).segments))
      setStyleConfig((target as any).style as StudioStyleConfig)
      saveStoredStyle((target as any).style)
      return prev.slice(0, -1)
    })
  }, [segments, styleConfig, setSegments])

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true
    setFontLoaded(false)
    ensureFontLoaded(fontId).then(() => active && setFontLoaded(true)).catch(() => active && setFontLoaded(true))
    return () => { active = false }
  }, [fontId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2600)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [toast])

  const handleFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (!file) return
    if (file.size > 250 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toastMsg('حجم فایل بیشتر از ۲۵۰ مگابایت است.')
      e.target.value = ''
      return
    }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    setFileName(file.name)
    setSourceFile(file)
    setVideoUrl(url)
    setSelectedSegId(null)
    setHistory([])
    setRedoStack([])
    setRestored(false)
    await run(file)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => { if (videoUrl.startsWith('blob:')) URL.revokeObjectURL(videoUrl) }
  }, [videoUrl])

  useEffect(() => {
    const v = videoRef.current
    if (!v) return
    const onTime = () => setCurrentTime(v.currentTime)
    const onMeta = () => setDuration(Number.isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration : 0)
    const onPlay = () => setIsPlaying(true)
    const onPause = () => setIsPlaying(false)
    v.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    v.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    v.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    return () => {
      v.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      v.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
    }
  }, [videoUrl])

  const activeSeg = useMemo(() => 
    segments.find((s: any) => currentTime >= s.start && currentTime < s.end) ?? null, 
    [segments, currentTime]
  )

  // ✅ اصلاح ۳: حذف بازنویسی خودکار انتخاب کاربر. هایلایت بصری توسط متغیر 'active' مدیریت می‌شود.

  const seek = useCallback((t: number) => {
    const v = videoRef.current
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(duration || Infinity, t))
    if (v) v.currentTime = next
    setCurrentTime(next)
  }, [duration])

  const togglePlay = useCallback(() => {
    const v = videoRef.current
    if (!v) return
    if (v.paused) v.play().catch(() => {})
    else v.pause()
  }, [])

  const splitAt = useCallback((id: string, at = currentTime) => {
    const seg = segments.find((s: any) => s.id === id)
    if (!seg || at <= seg.start + 0.05 || at >= seg.end - 0.05) {
      toastMsg('پلی‌هد باید داخل همان سگمنت باشد.')
      return
    }
    const before = makeSnapshot()
    const ratio = (at - seg.start) / Math.max(0.001, seg.end - seg.start)
    const words = seg.text.trim().split(/\s+/)
    const cut = Math.max(1, Math.min(words.length - 1, Math.round(words.length * ratio)))
    const first: any = { ...seg, id: seg.id || uid(), end: at, text: words.slice(0, cut).join(' ') || seg.text }
    const second: any = { ...seg, id: uid(), start: at, text: words.slice(cut).join(' ') || seg.text }
    recordBefore(before)
    setSegments(prev => prev.flatMap(s => s.id === id ? [first, second] : [s]))
    setSelectedSegId(second.id)
  }, [segments, currentTime, makeSnapshot, recordBefore, setSegments, toastMsg])

  const mergeSeg = useCallback((id: string) => {
    const idx = segments.findIndex((s: any) => s.id === id)
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= segments.length - 1) return
    const a = segments[idx]
    const b = segments[idx + 1]
    const before = makeSnapshot()
    recordBefore(before)
    setSegments(prev => prev.filter(s => s.id !== b.id).map(s => s.id === a.id ? { ...s, end: b.end, text: `${s.text} ${b.text}`.trim() } : s))
  }, [segments, makeSnapshot, recordBefore, setSegments])

  const deleteSeg = useCallback((id: string) => {
    const before = makeSnapshot()
    recordBefore(before)
    setSegments(prev => prev.filter(s => s.id !== id))
    setSelectedSegId(prev => prev === id ? null : prev)
  }, [makeSnapshot, recordBefore, setSegments])

  const addSeg = useCallback(() => {
    const start = currentTime
    const end = Math.min(duration || start + 2.5, start + 2.5)
    const before = makeSnapshot()
    recordBefore(before)
    const seg: any = { id: uid(), start, end: Math.max(start + .2, end), text: 'متن جدید' }
    setSegments(prev => [...prev, seg].sort((a: any, b: any) => a.start - b.start))
    setSelectedSegId(seg.id)
    setEditingSegId(seg.id)
  }, [currentTime, duration, makeSnapshot, recordBefore, setSegments])

  const onTimelinePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = timelineScrollRef.current
    if (!el || !duration) return
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement
    const block = target.closest('[data-seg-id]') as HTMLElement | null
    if (block) return
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const localX = e.clientX - rect.left + el.scrollLeft
    seek((localX / Math.max(1, el.scrollWidth)) * duration)
  }

  const beginSegDrag = (id: string, mode: 'move' | 'left' | 'right', e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    const seg = segments.find((s: any) => s.id === id)
    const el = timelineScrollRef.current
    if (!seg || !el || !duration) return
    setSelectedSegId(id)
    beforeDragRef.current = makeSnapshot()
    dragRef.current = { id, mode, startX: e.clientX, start: seg.start, end: seg.end }
    ;(e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
  }

  const onTimelinePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const drag = dragRef.current
    const el = timelineScrollRef.current
    if (!drag || !el || !duration) return
    const deltaPx = e.clientX - drag.startX
    const delta = (deltaPx / Math.max(1, el.scrollWidth)) * duration
    const minDur = 0.2
    let start = drag.start
    let end = drag.end
    if (drag.mode === 'move') {
      const len = drag.end - drag.start
      start = Math.max(0, Math.min(duration - len, drag.start + delta))
      end = start + len
    } else if (drag.mode === 'left') {
      start = Math.max(0, Math.min(drag.end - minDur, drag.start + delta))
    } else {
      end = Math.min(duration, Math.max(drag.start + minDur, drag.end + delta))
    }
    setSegments(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === drag.id ? { ...s, start, end } : s).sort((a: any, b: any) => a.start - b.start))
  }

  const endSegDrag = () => {
    if (!dragRef.current) return
    const before = beforeDragRef.current
    dragRef.current = null
    beforeDragRef.current = null
    if (before) recordBefore(before)
  }

  const applyPreset = (preset: Preset) => {
    updateStyle({
      template: preset.id,
      fontId: preset.fontId,
      fontFamily: preset.fontId,
      size: preset.size,
      color: preset.color,
      bgColor: preset.bgColor,
      bgOpacity: preset.bgOpacity,
      outline: preset.outline,
      karaoke: preset.karaoke,
      hlColor: preset.hlColor,
      textShadowBlur: preset.textShadowBlur,
      textShadowColor: preset.textShadowColor,
      bgRadius: preset.bgRadius,
    })
    toastMsg(`قالب «${preset.name}» اعمال شد.`)
  }

  const applyFont = (id: string) => updateStyle({ fontId: id, fontFamily: id })

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!canvas) return
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    updateStyle({ 
      x: Math.max(5, Math.min(95, ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100)), 
      y: Math.max(5, Math.min(95, ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100)) 
    })
  }

  const handleSubtitleDragStart = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!canvas) return
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    const clickX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100
    const clickY = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100
    const tolerance = 15
    if (Math.abs(clickX - x) < tolerance && Math.abs(clickY - y) < tolerance) {
      setIsDraggingSubtitle(true)
      subtitleDragStart.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, styleX: x, styleY: y }
    }
  }

  const handleSubtitleDragMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isDraggingSubtitle || !subtitleDragStart.current) return
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!canvas) return
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    const deltaX = e.clientX - subtitleDragStart.current.x
    const deltaY = e.clientY - subtitleDragStart.current.y
    const deltaXPercent = (deltaX / rect.width) * 100
    const deltaYPercent = (deltaY / rect.height) * 100
    const newX = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, subtitleDragStart.current.styleX + deltaXPercent))
    const newY = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, subtitleDragStart.current.styleY + deltaYPercent))
    updateStyle({ x: newX, y: newY }, false)
  }

  const handleSubtitleDragEnd = () => {
    if (isDraggingSubtitle) {
      setIsDraggingSubtitle(false)
      subtitleDragStart.current = null
      recordBefore()
    }
  }

  const handleCanvasDoubleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!canvas) return
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    const clickX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100
    const clickY = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100
    const tolerance = 15
    if (Math.abs(clickX - x) < tolerance && Math.abs(clickY - y) < tolerance) {
      const activeSegment = segments.find((s: any) => currentTime >= s.start && currentTime < s.end)
      if (activeSegment) {
        setCanvasEditText(activeSegment.text)
        setEditingOnCanvas(true)
      }
    }
  }

  const handleCanvasEditSave = () => {
    if (activeSeg && canvasEditText.trim()) {
      recordBefore()
      setSegments(prev => prev.map((s: any) => 
        s.id === activeSeg.id ? { ...s, text: canvasEditText.trim() } : s
      ))
      toastMsg('متن زیرنویس به‌روز شد.')
    }
    setEditingOnCanvas(false)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    if (!videoUrl) { setWaveform([]); return }
    ;(async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(videoUrl)
        const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer()
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext
        if (!AudioCtx) return
        const ctx = new AudioCtx()
        const audio = await ctx.decodeAudioData(buffer.slice(0))
        const channel = audio.getChannelData(0)
        const count = 700
        const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(channel.length / count))
        const peaks = new Array(count).fill(0).map((_, i) => {
          let peak = 0
          const end = Math.min(channel.length, (i + 1) * step)
          for (let j = i * step; j < end; j += 8) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(channel[j]))
          return Math.min(1, peak * 1.8)
        })
        if (!cancelled) setWaveform(peaks)
        await ctx.close()
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setWaveform([])
      }
    })()
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [videoUrl])

  const drawFrame = useCallback(() => {
    const video = videoRef.current
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!video || !canvas || video.readyState < 2) return
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
    if (!ctx) return
    let W = video.videoWidth || 1080
    let H = video.videoHeight || 1920
    if (style.aspectRatio === '9:16') { W = 1080; H = 1920 }
    else if (style.aspectRatio === '16:9') { W = 1920; H = 1080 }
    else if (style.aspectRatio === '1:1') { W = 1080; H = 1080 }
    else if (style.aspectRatio === '4:5') { W = 1080; H = 1350 }
    const out = clampCanvasDimensions(W, H, 1920)
    if (canvas.width !== out.width || canvas.height !== out.height) { 
      canvas.width = out.width
      canvas.height = out.height 
    }
    renderStudioFrame({ 
      ctx, 
      canvasWidth: out.width, 
      canvasHeight: out.height, 
      video, 
      currentTime: video.currentTime, 
      segments: segments as any, 
      style: styleConfig 
    })
  }, [segments, styleConfig, style])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!fontLoaded) return
    if (!isPlaying) { drawFrame(); return }
    let raf = 0
    const loop = () => { drawFrame(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop) }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
  }, [drawFrame, fontLoaded, isPlaying])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!segments.length || !fileName) return
    const project = { version: 2, fileName, segments, style: styleConfig, currentTime, savedAt: Date.now() }
    const key = `subtitle-project:${fileName}`
    setSaving(true)
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      try { 
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(project))
        setLastSaved(new Date())
        setSaving(false) 
      } catch { 
        setSaving(false)
        toastMsg('ذخیره خودکار انجام نشد.') 
      }
    }, 900)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [segments, styleConfig, fileName, currentTime, toastMsg])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!fileName || restored) return
    const key = `subtitle-project:${fileName}`
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key)
      if (!raw) { setRestored(true); return }
      const saved = JSON.parse(raw)
      if (saved?.segments?.length) {
        setSegments(clone(saved.segments))
        if (saved.style) {
          setStyleConfig(saved.style as StudioStyleConfig)
          saveStoredStyle(saved.style as any)
        }
        if (typeof saved.currentTime === 'number') seek(saved.currentTime)
        toastMsg('نسخه ذخیره‌شده بازیابی شد.')
      }
    } catch { /* ignore corrupt local draft */ }
    setRestored(true)
  }, [fileName, restored, setSegments, seek, toastMsg])

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = timelineScrollRef.current
    if (!el || !duration) return
    const xPx = (currentTime / duration) * el.scrollWidth
    const left = el.scrollLeft
    const right = left + el.clientWidth
    const margin = el.clientWidth * .22
    if (xPx < left + margin || xPx > right - margin) {
      el.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, xPx - el.clientWidth * .5), behavior: 'smooth' })
    }
  }, [currentTime, duration, timelineZoom])

  useEffect(() => {
    let resizeTimer: any
    const handleResize = () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer)
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => { drawFrame() }, 100)
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer)
    }
  }, [drawFrame])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = () => {
      if (segments.length && fileName) {
        const project = { version: 2, fileName, segments, style: styleConfig, currentTime, savedAt: Date.now() }
        const key = `subtitle-project:${fileName}`
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(project)) } catch {}
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload)
  }, [segments, styleConfig, fileName, currentTime])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null
      const editing = target?.tagName === 'INPUT' || target?.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || target?.isContentEditable
      if (editing && !(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) return
      const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey
      if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); undo(); return }
      if ((mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'y') || (mod && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z')) { e.preventDefault(); redo(); return }
      if (editing) return
      if (e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); togglePlay(); return }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); seek(currentTime - (e.shiftKey ? 1 : .1)); return }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); seek(currentTime + (e.shiftKey ? 1 : .1)); return }
      if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 's') { e.preventDefault(); const id = selectedSegId ?? activeSeg?.id; if (id) splitAt(id); return }
      if (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') { if (selectedSegId) { e.preventDefault(); deleteSeg(selectedSegId) } }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [undo, redo, currentTime, seek, selectedSegId, activeSeg?.id, splitAt, deleteSeg, togglePlay])

  const readingSpeed = (seg: any): number => seg.text.length / Math.max(.05, seg.end - seg.start)

  const handleTranslate = async (targetLang: 'fa' | 'en') => {
    if (!segments.length || translating) return
    setTranslating(true)
    try {
      const pad = (n: number, z = 2) => String(Math.floor(n)).padStart(z, '0')
      const time = (sec: number) => `${pad(sec / 3600)}:${pad((sec % 3600) / 60)}:${pad(sec % 60)},${String(Math.floor((sec % 1) * 1000)).padStart(3, '0')}`
      const srt = segments.map((s: any, i: number) => `${i + 1}\n${time(s.start)} --> ${time(s.end)}\n${s.text}`).join('\n\n')
      const res = await fetch('/api/translate-srt', { 
        method: 'POST', 
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, 
        body: JSON.stringify({ srtContent: srt, targetLang }) 
      })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('translate failed')
      const data = await res.json()
      if (!data.srt) throw new Error(data.error || 'پاسخی دریافت نشد')
      const parsed = data.srt.trim().replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split(/\n\s*\n/).map((b: string) => b.trim().split('\n').slice(2).join(' ').trim())
      recordBefore(makeSnapshot())
      setSegments(segments.map((seg: any, i: number) => ({ ...seg, text: parsed[i] || seg.text })))
      toastMsg('ترجمه انجام شد.')
    } catch { toastMsg('خطا در ترجمه.') }
    finally { setTranslating(false) }
  }

  const handleGenerateCaption = async () => {
    if (!segments.length || generatingCaption) return
    setGeneratingCaption(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/generate-caption', { 
        method: 'POST', 
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, 
        body: JSON.stringify({ text: segments.map((s: any) => s.text).join(' '), language: 'fa', style: 'instagram' }) 
      })
      const data = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok || !data.caption) throw new Error(data.error || 'خطا')
      setCaptionText(data.caption)
      setCaptionHashtags(data.hashtags || '')
      toastMsg('کپشن اینستاگرام ساخته شد.')
    } catch (e: any) { toastMsg(`خطا در تولید کپشن: ${e?.message || 'نامشخص'}`) }
    finally { setGeneratingCaption(false) }
  }

  if (!videoUrl) {
    return <UploadScreen onFileSelect={handleFile} />
  }

  const timelineWidth = Math.max(100, timelineZoom)

  return (
    <div className="flex h-[100dvh] min-h-0 w-full min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#070605] text-white transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out" dir="rtl">
      <header className="shrink-0 border-b border-stone-800 bg-[#110f0d] px-3 py-2">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <h1 className="min-w-0 max-w-[22rem] truncate text-sm font-black">{fileName}</h1>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">{saving ? 'در حال ذخیره…' : lastSaved ? `ذخیره ${fmt(lastSaved.getTime() / 1000)}` : ''}</span>
          <div className="mr-auto flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            <button aria-label="Undo" onClick={undo} disabled={!history.length} className="rounded-lg bg-stone-800 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-30"></button>
            <button aria-label="Redo" onClick={redo} disabled={!redoStack.length} className="rounded-lg bg-stone-800 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-30">↷</button>
            <button onClick={() => setShowStyle(true)} className="rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-400">⚙ استایل</button>
            <button onClick={() => setShowExport(true)} className="rounded-xl bg-amber-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-black text-black">خروجی MP4</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col lg:flex-row">
        <section className="flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col bg-black transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out">
          {busy && (
            <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-14 z-30 w-[min(28rem,calc(100%-2rem))] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/40 bg-stone-900/95 p-3">
              <div className="mb-1 flex justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-amber-400">{status}</span>
                <button onClick={stop} className="text-red-400">توقف</button>
              </div>
              <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-stone-800">
                <div className="h-full bg-amber-500" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4">
            <canvas 
              ref={canvasRef} 
              onClick={handleCanvasClick}
              onMouseDown={handleSubtitleDragStart}
              onMouseMove={handleSubtitleDragMove}
              onMouseUp={handleSubtitleDragEnd}
              onMouseLeave={handleSubtitleDragEnd}
              onDoubleClick={handleCanvasDoubleClick}
              className={`block max-h-full max-w-full ${isDraggingSubtitle ? 'cursor-grabbing' : 'cursor-crosshair'} object-contain`} 
            />
            <video ref={videoRef} src={videoUrl} className="hidden" playsInline />
          </div>

          <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-stone-800 bg-[#110f0d] px-3 py-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button aria-label={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'} onClick={togglePlay} className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-black">
                {isPlaying ? '⏸' : '▶'}
              </button>
              <input 
                aria-label="Video progress" 
                type="range" 
                min={0} 
                max={duration || 1} 
                step={.05} 
                value={currentTime} 
                onChange={e => seek(Number(e.target.value))} 
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 accent-amber-500" 
              />
              <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[10px] text-stone-400">{fmt(currentTime)} / {fmt(duration)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-stone-800 bg-[#0e0d0b] p-2 sm:p-3">
            <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-400">Timeline</span>
              <input 
                aria-label="Timeline zoom" 
                type="range" 
                min={50} 
                max={800} 
                value={timelineZoom} 
                onChange={e => setTimelineZoom(Number(e.target.value))} 
                className="w-28 accent-amber-500" 
              />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">{timelineZoom}%</span>
              <button onClick={() => setShowSafe(v => !v)} className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] ${showSafe ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black' : 'bg-stone-800 text-stone-400'}`}>Safe Zone</button>
              <button onClick={() => { const id = selectedSegId ?? activeSeg?.id; if (id) splitAt(id) }} className="rounded-lg bg-stone-800 px-2 py-1 text-[10px]"> Split</button>
              <button onClick={() => selectedSegId && mergeSeg(selectedSegId)} className="rounded-lg bg-stone-800 px-2 py-1 text-[10px]">Merge</button>
              <button onClick={addSeg} className="rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-amber-400">+ افزودن</button>
              <button onClick={() => handleTranslate('fa')} disabled={translating} className="rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-blue-400">ترجمه FA</button>
              <button onClick={() => handleTranslate('en')} disabled={translating} className="rounded-lg bg-green-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-green-400">ترجمه EN</button>
              <button onClick={handleGenerateCaption} disabled={generatingCaption} className="rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-purple-400">کپشن AI</button>
            </div>

            <div 
              ref={timelineScrollRef} 
              onPointerDown={onTimelinePointerDown} 
              onPointerMove={onTimelinePointerMove} 
              onPointerUp={endSegDrag} 
              onPointerCancel={endSegDrag} 
              className="relative h-24 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden rounded-xl bg-stone-950 overscroll-x-contain" 
              style={{ scrollbarGutter: 'stable' }}
            >
              <div className="relative h-full" style={{ width: `${timelineWidth}%`, minWidth: '100%' }}>
                <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex justify-between px-1 text-[8px] text-stone-600">
                  <span>0:00</span>
                  <span>{fmt(duration)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 top-7 flex items-end gap-px px-1 opacity-25">
                  {waveform.map((v, i) => (
                    <span key={`wave-${i}`} className="min-w-[1px] flex-1 rounded-t bg-stone-300" style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, v * 100)}%` }} />
                  ))}
                </div>
                {segments.map((seg: any) => {
                  const safeId = seg.id || uid()
                  const left = duration ? (seg.start / duration) * 100 : 0
                  const width = duration ? ((seg.end - seg.start) / duration) * 100 : 0
                  const fast = readingSpeed(seg) > 17
                  const selected = selectedSegId === seg.id
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={safeId} 
                      data-seg-id={safeId} 
                      onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); setSelectedSegId(safeId); seek(seg.start) }} 
                      className={`absolute bottom-2 top-7 rounded-lg border cursor-pointer ${
                        selected ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-500/60' : 'border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/25'
                      } ${fast ? 'ring-2 ring-red-500/80' : ''}`} 
                      style={{ left: `${left}%`, width: `${Math.max(width, .35)}%`, minWidth: 16 }}
                    >
                      <div 
                        onPointerDown={e => beginSegDrag(safeId, 'left', e)} 
                        className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-20 w-2 cursor-ew-resize rounded-l bg-amber-400/60" 
                      />
                      <div 
                        onPointerDown={e => beginSegDrag(safeId, 'move', e)} 
                        className="absolute inset-0 cursor-grab px-2 py-2 text-[9px] text-white active:cursor-grabbing"
                      >
                        <span className="block truncate">{seg.text}</span>
                        {fast && <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-1 text-[8px] text-red-300">CPS {readingSpeed(seg).toFixed(1)}</span>}
                      </div>
                      <div 
                        onPointerDown={e => beginSegDrag(safeId, 'right', e)} 
                        className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 z-20 w-2 cursor-ew-resize rounded-r bg-amber-400/60" 
                      />
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
                <div 
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 top-0 z-30 w-0.5 bg-amber-400" 
                  style={{ left: `${duration ? (currentTime / duration) * 100 : 0}%` }} 
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <aside className="flex max-h-[42vh] min-h-0 w-full shrink-0 flex-col border-t border-stone-800 bg-[#0e0d0b] transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out lg:max-h-none lg:w-[min(400px,38vw)] lg:border-l lg:border-t-0">
          <div className="shrink-0 border-b border-stone-800 bg-[#12100d] p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold">کپشن‌ها ({segments.length})</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">CPS بالای 17 = هشدار</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-2">
            {segments.map((seg: any) => {
              const safeId = seg.id || uid()
              const selected = selectedSegId === seg.id
              const active = activeSeg?.id === seg.id
              const fast = readingSpeed(seg) > 17
              return (
                <div 
                  key={safeId} 
                  className={`rounded-xl border ${
                    active ? 'border-amber-500/70 bg-amber-500/10' 
                    : selected ? 'border-amber-500/40 bg-stone-800/70' 
                    : 'border-stone-800 bg-stone-900/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 border-b border-stone-800/70 p-2">
                    <button onClick={() => seek(seg.start)} className="font-mono text-[10px] text-amber-400">{fmt(seg.start)}</button>
                    <span className="text-stone-600">→</span>
                    <button onClick={() => seek(seg.end)} className="font-mono text-[10px] text-amber-400">{fmt(seg.end)}</button>
                    <span className={`mr-auto text-[9px] ${fast ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-stone-500'}`}>
                      CPS {readingSpeed(seg).toFixed(1)}
                    </span>
                    <button aria-label="Split caption" onClick={() => splitAt(safeId)} className="rounded bg-stone-800 px-1.5 py-1 text-[10px]">✂</button>
                    <button aria-label="Merge caption" onClick={() => mergeSeg(safeId)} className="rounded bg-stone-800 px-1.5 py-1 text-[10px]">↔</button>
                    <button aria-label="Delete caption" onClick={() => deleteSeg(safeId)} className="rounded bg-red-500/10 px-1.5 py-1 text-[10px] text-red-400">✕</button>
                  </div>
                  {editingSegId === safeId ? (
                    <textarea 
                      autoFocus 
                      dir="auto" 
                      value={seg.text} 
                      onChange={e => setSegments((prev: any[]) => prev.map(s => s.id === safeId ? { ...s, text: e.target.value } : s))} 
                      onBlur={() => { 
                        if (beforeEditRef.current) recordBefore(beforeEditRef.current)
                        beforeEditRef.current = null
                        setEditingSegId(null) 
                      }} 
                      onKeyDown={e => { 
                        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter') { 
                          e.preventDefault()
                          ;(e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).blur() 
                        } 
                      }} 
                      className="m-2 w-[calc(100%-1rem)] resize-none rounded-lg border border-amber-500/50 bg-black/50 p-2 text-xs outline-none" 
                      rows={3} 
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => { 
                        beforeEditRef.current = makeSnapshot()
                        setEditingSegId(safeId)
                        setSelectedSegId(safeId) 
                      }} 
                      className="block w-full p-2 text-right text-xs leading-6 text-white/90" 
                      dir="auto"
                    >
                      {seg.text}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
          {(captionText || captionHashtags) && (
            <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-stone-800 bg-[#12100d] p-3">
              <h4 className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold">کپشن اینستاگرام</h4>
              <textarea 
                value={captionText + (captionHashtags ? `\n\n${captionHashtags}` : '')} 
                onChange={e => { 
                  const parts = e.target.value.split('\n\n')
                  setCaptionText(parts[0] || '')
                  setCaptionHashtags(parts.slice(1).join('\n\n')) 
                }} 
                className="mb-2 w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-stone-700 bg-black/40 p-2 text-xs" 
                rows={4} 
              />
              <button 
                onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(captionText + (captionHashtags ? `\n\n${captionHashtags}` : '')).then(() => toastMsg('کپی شد.')).catch(() => toastMsg('کپی انجام نشد.'))} 
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-400"
              >
                📋 کپی کپشن
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </aside>
      </main>

      {showSafe && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-20 hidden border-t border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 lg:block" style={{ height: '0px' }} />
      )}

      {showStyle && (
        <StylePanel
          style={style}
          fontId={fontId}
          onClose={() => setShowStyle(false)}
          onApplyPreset={applyPreset}
          onApplyFont={applyFont}
          onUpdateStyle={updateStyle}
          makeSnapshot={makeSnapshot}
          recordBefore={recordBefore}
        />
      )}

      {/* ✅ اصلاح ۲: استفاده از هوک پیشرفته useVideoExport */}
      {showExport && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 p-3" onMouseDown={() => !exporting && setShowExport(false)}>
          <div 
            onMouseDown={e => e.stopPropagation()} 
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl border border-stone-800 bg-[#14120f] p-6 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">خروجی نهایی ویدیو</h3>
              {!exporting && <button onClick={() => setShowExport(false)} className="text-stone-400 hover:text-white">✕</button>}
            </div>
            
            {exporting ? (
              <div className="space-y-4 text-center">
                <div className="text-xs text-amber-400 font-mono">{exportStage || 'در حال پردازش...'}</div>
                <div className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-stone-800">
                  <div className="h-full bg-amber-500 transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${exportProgress}%` }} />
                </div>
                <button onClick={cancelExport} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/20">
                  لغو عملیات
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 text-center">
                  ویدیو با نسبت تصویر <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{(styleConfig as any).aspectRatio || '16:9'}</span> و کیفیت بالا رندر خواهد شد.
                </p>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => exportVideo(videoUrl, segments as any, styleConfig as any, fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ''))}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-500 py-3 text-xs font-black text-black transition-all hover:from-amber-500 hover:to-amber-400"
                >
                  شروع رندر و دانلود MP4 ⚡
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {editingOnCanvas && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[150] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50" onMouseDown={() => setEditingOnCanvas(false)}>
          <div 
            onMouseDown={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/50 bg-[#12100d] p-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-white">ویرایش متن زیرنویس</h3>
            <textarea
              autoFocus
              value={canvasEditText}
              onChange={e => setCanvasEditText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={e => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
                  e.preventDefault()
                  handleCanvasEditSave()
                }
                if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditingOnCanvas(false)
              }}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-stone-700 bg-black/50 p-3 text-sm text-white focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
              rows={3}
              dir="rtl"
            />
            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
              <button onClick={handleCanvasEditSave} className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-black">ذخیره (Ctrl+Enter)</button>
              <button onClick={() => setEditingOnCanvas(false)} className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-stone-800 py-2 text-xs text-stone-300">انصراف (Esc)</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {toast && (
        <div role="status" aria-live="polite" className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 z-[200] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-xl border border-stone-700 bg-stone-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs shadow-2xl">
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { Seg } from './types'

interface Props {
  segments: Seg[]
  duration: number
  currentTime: number
  selectedSegId: string | null
  timelineZoom: number
  waveform: number[]
  readingSpeed: (seg: Seg) => number
  onSeek: (time: number) => void
  onSegmentClick: (id: string) => void
  onDragStart: (id: string, mode: 'move' | 'left' | 'right', e: React.PointerEvent) => void
  onDragMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void
  onDragEnd: () => void
}

export default function Timeline({
  segments, duration, currentTime, selectedSegId, timelineZoom, waveform,
  readingSpeed, onSeek, onSegmentClick, onDragStart, onDragMove, onDragEnd
}: Props) {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const fmt = (t: number) => `${Math.floor(t / 60)}:${Math.floor(t % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`

  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = scrollRef.current
    if (!el || !duration) return
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('[data-seg-id]')) return
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const localX = e.clientX - rect.left + el.scrollLeft
    onSeek((localX / Math.max(1, el.scrollWidth)) * duration)
  }

  return (
    <div ref={scrollRef} onPointerDown={handleTimelineClick} onPointerMove={onDragMove} onPointerUp={onDragEnd} onPointerCancel={onDragEnd} className="relative h-24 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden rounded-xl bg-stone-950" style={{ scrollbarGutter: 'stable' }}>
      <div className="relative h-full" style={{ width: `${timelineZoom}%`, minWidth: '100%' }}>
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex justify-between px-1 text-[8px] text-stone-600"><span>0:00</span><span>{fmt(duration)}</span></div>
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 top-7 flex items-end gap-px px-1 opacity-25">
          {waveform.map((v, i) => <span key={i} className="min-w-[1px] flex-1 rounded-t bg-stone-300" style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, v * 100)}%` }} />)}
        </div>
        {segments.map((seg) => {
          const left = duration ? (seg.start / duration) * 100 : 0
          const width = duration ? ((seg.end - seg.start) / duration) * 100 : 0
          const fast = readingSpeed(seg) > 17
          const selected = selectedSegId === seg.id
          const safeId = seg.id || `fallback_${seg.start}_${seg.end}`
    return (
            <div key={safeId} data-seg-id={safeId} onClick={() => onSegmentClick(safeId)} className={`absolute bottom-2 top-7 rounded-lg border cursor-pointer ${selected ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-500/60' : 'border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/25'} ${fast ? 'ring-2 ring-red-500/80' : ''}`} style={{ left: `${left}%`, width: `${Math.max(width, 0.35)}%`, minWidth: 16 }}>
              <div onPointerDown={(e) => onDragStart(safeId, 'left', e)} className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-20 w-2 cursor-ew-resize rounded-l bg-amber-400/60" />
              <div onPointerDown={(e) => onDragStart(safeId, 'move', e)} className="absolute inset-0 cursor-grab px-2 py-2 text-[9px] text-white active:cursor-grabbing">
                <span className="block truncate">{seg.text}</span>
                {fast && <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-1 text-[8px] text-red-300">CPS {readingSpeed(seg).toFixed(1)}</span>}
              </div>
              <div onPointerDown={(e) => onDragStart(safeId, 'right', e)} className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 z-20 w-2 cursor-ew-resize rounded-r bg-amber-400/60" />
            </div>
          )
        })}
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 top-0 z-30 w-0.5 bg-amber-400" style={{ left: `${duration ? (currentTime / duration) * 100 : 0}%` }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export type Seg = {

export const MAX_AUDIO_MB = 20

let cachedFFmpeg: any = null

async function getFFmpegForAudio(): Promise<any> {
  if (cachedFFmpeg && cachedFFmpeg.loaded) return cachedFFmpeg

  const { FFmpeg } = await import('@ffmpeg/ffmpeg')
  const { toBlobURL } = await import('@ffmpeg/util')

  const ffmpeg = new FFmpeg()
  const baseURL = 'https://unpkg.com/@ffmpeg/core@0.12.6/dist/umd'
  const coreURL = await toBlobURL(`${baseURL}/ffmpeg-core.js`, 'text/javascript')
  const wasmURL = await toBlobURL(`${baseURL}/ffmpeg-core.wasm`, 'application/wasm')
  await ffmpeg.load({ coreURL, wasmURL })

  cachedFFmpeg = ffmpeg
  return ffmpeg
}

// هر فایل ورودی (mp4, mov, mkv, ...) را به یک WAV تک‌کاناله‌ی ۱۶کیلوهرتز تبدیل می‌کند.
// چرا این لایه لازم است: decodeAudioData در سافاری با کدک/کانتینر بعضی فایل‌های mov
// ضبط‌شده با آیفون مشکل دارد و «Decoding failed» می‌دهد؛ ولی یک WAV ساده همیشه و در همه‌ی
// مرورگرها بدون مشکل دیکود می‌شود. ffmpeg همین الان در پروژه برای export ویدیو استفاده
// می‌شود، همان را این‌جا هم به کار می‌گیریم تا مستقل از کدک اصلی صوت، خروجی یکسان بگیریم.
async function extractCleanWav(file: Blob): Promise<ArrayBuffer> {
  const ffmpeg = await getFFmpegForAudio()
  const inName = 'audio_src_input'
  const outName = 'audio_clean_16k.wav'

  await ffmpeg.writeFile(inName, new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()))
  await ffmpeg.exec(['-i', inName, '-vn', '-ac', '1', '-ar', '16000', '-f', 'wav', outName])
  const data = (await ffmpeg.readFile(outName)) as Uint8Array

  await ffmpeg.deleteFile(inName).catch(() => {})
  await ffmpeg.deleteFile(outName).catch(() => {})

  // یک کپی واقعی از بافر برمی‌گردانیم تا به حافظه‌ی داخلی ffmpeg.wasm وابسته نماند
  return data.slice().buffer
}

export async function decodeToPcm16k(file: Blob): Promise<AudioBuffer> {
  const wavBuffer = await extractCleanWav(file)

  const Ctx = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext
  const tmp = new Ctx()
  const decoded = await tmp.decodeAudioData(wavBuffer)
  await tmp.close()

  const rate = 16000
  const offline = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(decoded.duration * rate), rate)
  const src = offline.createBufferSource()
  src.buffer = decoded
  src.connect(offline.destination)
  src.start()
  return offline.startRendering()
}

export function bufferToBase64Chunks(
  buf: AudioBuffer,
  chunkSec = 1
): { data: string; seconds: number }[] {
  const samples = buf.getChannelData(0)
  const rate = buf.sampleRate
  const chunkLen = Math.floor(rate * chunkSec)
  const out: { data: string; seconds: number }[] = []

  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i += chunkLen) {
    const slice = samples.subarray(i, Math.min(i + chunkLen, samples.length))
    const pcm16 = new Int16Array(slice.length)
    for (let j = 0; j < slice.length; j++) {
      pcm16[j] = Math.max(-32768, Math.min(32767, Math.round(slice[j] * 32767)))
    }

    // بایت‌های خالص خام PCM بدون هیچ‌گونه هدر WAV
    const pcmBytes = new Uint8Array(pcm16.buffer)
    let binary = ''
    for (let k = 0; k < pcmBytes.length; k += 0x8000) {
      binary += String.fromCharCode(...pcmBytes.subarray(k, k + 0x8000))
    }
    out.push({ data: btoa(binary), seconds: slice.length / rate })
  }
  return out
}
